Subject: Need help with a tenancy eviction case

Hello, my name is Asha Kurian. I am a 49-year-old retired bank officer living in Kolkata. I have a tenancy problem with Ravi Rajan involving Rs 2,25,000 in rent, and the landlord is trying to evict the tenant after a rent increase was refused. My case number is R.C.A. No. 2240/2019 in the Kolkata District Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 07349571674 or email asha.kurian58@example.in.
